name: Mindless Box
source:
"Mindless Box" is a dating sim from Maimie's Toybox about magic, ghosts and romance. Players will join the young witch Emily as she fumbles her way through a seemingly mundane punishment. Spending her nights cleaning a set of old classrooms for the use of Autumn Harvest Academy, she soon finds a dirty secret buried within. As it cracks, leaking negative energy among other things into the air, she soon finds herself battling against a dark magic. A dear friend is sacrificed, another betrays her. Emily soon questions the very things that make her her and just how much good the academy has done for her. 

It’s up to the player to make sure she doesn’t lose sight of herself as well as helping the boy of their choosing find themselves. Mindless Box is a tale of family, love and demons; both inside and out.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190110135156/https://maimiestoybox.tumblr.com/post/151902986017/finally-here-is-the-updated-demo-for-mindless]Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
“Mindless Box”是Maimie's Toybox推出的一款关于魔法、鬼魂和浪漫的约会模拟游戏。玩家将与年轻的女巫艾米丽一起，摸索着通过看似平凡的惩罚。她花了晚上的时间清理秋收学院使用的一套旧教室，很快她就发现了里面隐藏着一个肮脏的秘密。当它破裂，将负能量和其他东西泄漏到空气中时，她很快发现自己正在与黑暗魔法作斗争。一位亲爱的朋友被牺牲，另一位则背叛了她。艾米丽很快就开始质疑是什么造就了她，以及学院为她做了多少好事。

玩家有责任确保她不会迷失自己，并帮助他们选择的男孩找到自己。《无心盒子》是一个关于家庭、爱情和恶魔的故事；无论是内部还是外部。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190110135156/https://maimiestoybox.tumblr.com/post/151902986017/finally-here-is-the-updated-demo-for-mindless]Tumblr[/url]]
